title: Everyone Should Build Their Own Network Stack
summary: A technical blog post (part 2 of a series) about building your own network infrastructure using DN42 (Decentralized Network 42), a private network experiment that allows enthusiasts to practice networking skills like BGP routing and VPN configuration in a real-world environment without relying on commercial ISPs.
problem_solved: Provides hands-on networking education by guiding readers through building personal network infrastructure from scratch
why_valuable: Fills the gap between theoretical networking knowledge and practical experience by offering a safe, legal sandbox to experiment with real-world protocols and configurations
